answer_sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, the no-pre-payment-charge rule applies only to loans with a sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh, so an ₹80 lakh sanction is outside that cited prohibition.
answer_sentences.quote: "A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh."

answer_sentences.text: The sanction letter’s 2% pre-payment charge is stated as "2% of the amount prepaid," but the cited Tier 3 UCB rule does not extend that no-charge restriction to an ₹80 lakh loan.
The RBI directions likewise say a Tier 3 Primary (Urban) Co-operative bank shall not levy any pre-payment charges only "on loans with sanctioned amount/ limit up to ₹50 lakh."
answer_sentences.quote: "A Small Finance bank, a Regional Rural bank, a Tier 3 Primary (Urban) Co- operative bank, State Cooperative bank, Central Cooperative bank and an NBFC- ML shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/ limit up to ₹50 lakh."
